title: The Mindless starter kits, block defaults and sample emails coach the owner instead of carrying the Mindless brand's words

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write." Daniel 2026-11-19: "Make Sure Mindless and Honey have their full theme kit with all designs."

detail: LIVE-2407 offered Mindless and left its template scrub as its own row. The Mindless block defaults (lib/sites/mindless-home.ts), the starter kits (lib/sites/kits/mindless-variants.ts and the profile index) and the sample email brand (lib/email-samples/catalog.ts) carried the Mindless brand's own place, prices, dates, counts, host name and testimonials. They now coach the owner what to write, the way Nocturne, Temple and New World were scrubbed (LIVE-2372..2375). Block render reads saved props, never these defaults, so saved pages do not change. The theme page pictures are redrawn from the scrubbed defaults, and the Mindless home render takes ML_ACCENT to draw any paint.
